    GPA requirements

    • Minimum cumulative 2.000 GPA required in all CS, CY, DS, and IS courses

    Substitutions

    Stated by the catalog on this program's requirements:

    • Students may fulﬁll one course during each co-op or take two courses instead of vacation.

    Possible equivalents for this program beyond the above — dashed means a suggestion, not a rule, and every substitution needs your advisor's approval:

    • ENGW 1102 ↔ ENGW 1111 (tier C)
    • ENGW 3302 ↔ ENGW 3306 (tier C)
    • INTL 5100 ↔ PPUA 5100 (tier B)
    • MATH 1241 ↔ MATH 1341 (tier C)
